digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Today is Thursday, August 6, with nine scheduled meetings, three hard conflicts, five urgent items, and no carry-overs; every action from yesterday is marked complete in dashboard state. The day turns on Amazon Connect readiness at noon and the competing Service Cloud and SMS sessions at 2:00 PM. First, set the governance path for the overlapping OAA Brain initiative, then absorb the new VAWA legal guidance, clear the critical Court escalation, and protect owners and decisions across the compressed meeting run.

items.label: 10:00-11:30 AM - Amazon training and back-to-back 1:1s
items.detail: Start with the Amazon Connect training touchpoint, then use Armando and Thiago's consecutive 1:1s to confirm owners and any delivery tradeoffs before the noon project sync.

items.label: 12:00 PM - Amazon Connect sync overlaps Blocked Space
items.detail: The weekly sync is the priority decision window for UAT blockers and readiness. Preserve the remaining protected time for follow-through once owners and dates are clear.

items.label: 1:00 PM - Case Withdrawal and BCP overlap
items.detail: Case Withdrawal Template Validation runs until 1:45 PM while the BCP/Incident Response weekly begins at 1:30 PM. Choose Jean's primary room and assign coverage before noon.

items.label: 2:00 PM - Service Cloud Q&A and SMS status conflict
items.detail: Service Cloud launches Saturday and its leader Q&A requires the Rippling training; SMS Optimization is also active and reviewing risks and blockers. Pick the live priority and route coverage for the other.

items.label: 3:00-5:00 PM - Prep window and Tudo Bem weekly
items.detail: Use the 3:00 PM focus hour to consolidate decisions and unresolved owners before the 4:00 PM team forum for project progress and roadblock removal.

items.label: Set the governance path for OAA Brain
items.detail: Teams discussion indicates Jim's August initiative overlaps Legal Change Management, has not completed Legal or IT approval, and still needs development. Align with Jim on the required review path and keep current work anchored to the approved Legal Change Management solution until the gaps are resolved.

items.label: Confirm Amazon Connect UAT readiness
items.detail: Use the noon sync and Jennifer Gold's unread SCV update to reconcile open build and configuration work, assign each blocker, and protect the August 13 Round 1 UAT target and August 27 go/no-go.

items.label: Re-plan VAWA PA 21 testing after the legal change
items.detail: Legal guidance removed a previously required UI section, and Isabella is updating the user story. Confirm the revised scope, testing sequence, and Nicolas/Jean UAT coverage so the handoff does not drift while Jessie is away.

items.label: Route the critical Court A-number visibility item
items.detail: Maria changed the Court Matters A-number visibility work to Critical in Asana. Confirm the responsible owner, whether it affects the current Court bundle, and the escalation checkpoint needed today.

items.label: Resolve today's three meeting overlaps
items.detail: Set coverage for Amazon Connect versus Blocked Space, Case Withdrawal versus BCP, and Service Cloud versus SMS. Complete the Service Cloud prerequisite training if that Q&A is the live priority.

items.label: Review Yash's Latent Variables reply
items.detail: An unread reply arrived after yesterday's testing task was closed. Check whether it changes the fieldwork decision or needs a concise response before the afternoon meeting stack.

items.label: Sara remains in the Dublin office
items.detail: Her travel block continues through Friday; use today's decisions to make tomorrow's EPMO EOW check-in concrete.

items.label: Friday morning stacks Legal, hiring, Service Cloud, and Amazon ownership
items.detail: The 10:00 AM Legal sync leads into a 10:30 AM PM III interview that overlaps the 11:00 AM Service Cloud Q&A. Amazon ownership review follows at 11:30 AM, with Mar out for the day.

items.label: Friday afternoon is a continuous EPMO and Salesforce run
items.detail: Protected time at noon is followed by EPMO EOW, Laura's 1:1, Salesforce standup, project pipeline, and the executive status deck through 3:30 PM. Prepare decisions and status inputs before lunch.
